evidence: The ZnO thin films were synthesized using standard precursors, such as diethylzinc [DEZ, Zn(C2H5)2] ... and O2 gas (stand-alone bottle, Air Liquide, alpha 2 O2 global purity ≥ 99.9995 % mol with less than 0.5 H2O ppm.mol impurity) in a commercial atomic layer deposition reactor (TFS-200, Beneq, Finland).
